title: Regideso day workers’ sit-in over pay and work conditions
location: Buyenzi, Bujumbura; exact office address not stated
scope: Single reported sit-in in Bujumbura. Article says workers had suspended work since Monday; the public sit-in was Tuesday. No other site or crowd count pooled.
organizer: Regideso day workers; specific organizer not named.
participants_original: More than 500 day workers at the sit-in, as reported by RPA.
threshold_50_evidence: The source explicitly describes more than 500 workers at the single Buyenzi sit-in.

start_date.summary: Workers had suspended activities since Monday; the article is dated Wednesday 4 November 2020, making 2 November a calendar inference.

end_date.summary: The duration or end of work stoppage/sit-in is not reported.

location.summary: RPA places the sit-in outside Regideso offices in Buyenzi, Bujumbura.

scope.summary: Count and location refer only to one Buyenzi sit-in; no other locations included.

organizer.summary: Workers are identified; no named union/organizer for the sit-in is stated.

demands.summary: Workers requested higher pay and timely wages, citing long tenure without contracts, cost of living and working conditions.

participants_original.summary: The report says more than 500 day workers participated in the sit-in.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: More than 500 people are described at the single gathering.

state_response.summary: No response to the sit-in is documented in the consulted passage; unknown.

state_target.summary: The report frames the claims as addressed to the employer, Regideso. It does not establish that wage rates or conditions were determined by domestic state policy or that workers demanded action from government.

notes: Substantive candidate retained, not included/verified. Codebook requires a government/state-policy target; the source documents an employer-directed labor dispute and does not establish the needed state-policy relation. Calendar dates are derived from weekday wording and not independently checked.
